📺 Fresh Off the Boat (2015–2020)

Fresh Off the Boat follows the Huang family, a Taiwanese-American family who moves from Washington, D.C., to Orlando, Florida, during the 1990s in search of new opportunities and a better future. At the center of the story is Eddie Huang, a young boy who loves hip-hop music, basketball, and American pop culture while trying to fit in at his new school. His hardworking father Louis dreams of building a successful restaurant business, while his strict and determined mother Jessica works tirelessly to keep the family focused on education, discipline, and their cultural traditions. Alongside Eddie’s younger brothers Emery and Evan and their outspoken grandmother, the family experiences hilarious misunderstandings, unexpected adventures, and everyday challenges. As they adjust to their new surroundings, the Huangs learn to balance their Taiwanese heritage with American culture while supporting one another through life’s ups and downs. Combining clever comedy, heartfelt family moments, and nostalgic 1990s storytelling, the series explores identity, immigration, parenting, cultural differences, and the importance of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Sitcom • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 6 seasons • 116 episodes

🎥 Creator: Nahnatchka Khan

🏆 Recognition: Starring Randall Park, Constance Wu, Hudson Yang, Forrest Wheeler, Ian Chen, and Lucille Soong, the series became a landmark in Asian-American representation on network television. Inspired by chef Eddie Huang’s memoir, it was the first Asian-American family sitcom on American network television in two decades. The show received praise for its humor, cultural representation, memorable characters, and heartfelt portrayal of immigrant family life.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu and Disney+ in select regions. Also check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Fresh Off the Boat is an American television sitcom created by Nahnatchka Khan and produced by 20th Century Fox Television for ABC. It is loosely inspired by the life of chef and food personality Eddie Huang and his 2013 autobiography of the same name. Huang was the executive producer of the series, and narrated its first season. Depicting the life of a Taiwanese-American family in Florida in the 1990s, the series stars Randall Park, Constance Wu, Hudson Yang, Forrest Wheeler, Ian Chen, and Lucille Soong as the Huang family as well as Chelsey Crisp and Ray Wise portraying the family's next-door neighbors.
